name: komdosh-dev-spring-core
description: The must-have foundation for Kotlin + Spring WebFlux/coroutines services: implementation, events, and Avro schemas in one plugin. 8 agents (backend-implementer, test-writer, cleanuper, integration-debugger, service-bootstrapper, event-consumer-author, avro-schema-author, and the read-only code-reviewer that reviews a diff at scope=diff or audits the whole service at scope=service) · 13 commands · 11 skills (coroutine-safety-scan, module-boundary-check, pii-safety-scan, liquibase-changeset-immutability, jooq-generation-freshness, pre-edit-impact-check, check-adr-required, read-service-context, run-verification, discover-avro-toolchain, verify-schema-compat) · 19 rule documents · 2 hooks. Enforces hexagonal boundaries, the 12 forbidden coroutine patterns, RFC 9457 errors, application-layer PII handling, event-consumer idempotency and DLQ policy, and Avro schema/registry discipline.
